quality_definition: All promotion-blocking gates pass with reproducible evidence and accepted residual risk; no percentage quality claim is permitted.

phases.objective: Close domain-quality, supply-chain, identity-isolation, accessibility, security, and records-control gates before pilot.
Qualify approved endpoint profiles, packaging, recovery, performance, and operational ownership.
Add credential, archive, and Zoom capabilities only after their separate threat-model and connector gates pass.

gates.title: Representative transcription quality
exit_criteria: An approved sealed multilingual, noise, speaker, and domain dataset is versioned without production recordings.
Word-error and meaning-impact measures are reported by subgroup against the pinned model baseline.
A qualified human reviewer accepts the consequential-error threshold and documented limitations.
blockers: ASSUMPTION: 46-fixture synthetic eval harness committed (evidence/eval/); WER thresholds are draft INFERENCE pending domain SME. Real recording dataset and qualified human reviewer acceptance are required before this gate can close.
gates.next_action: Domain evaluation lead reviews evidence/eval/threshold-protocol.json, provides real recording dataset (minimum 20 domain cases), and accepts or rejects WER thresholds.

gates.title: Deployment and software supply chain
exit_criteria: The full transitive runtime set has an approved SBOM and vulnerability disposition.
A signed Windows package passes clean-machine install, repair, upgrade, uninstall, and rollback tests.
Package, model, FFmpeg, and installer hashes are attested for the approved endpoint matrix.
blockers: STS-110 build automation committed: offline wheelhouse script, MSIX build layout, hash verification, and 19 installer tests. Clean-machine evidence template committed (evidence/installer/clean-machine-matrix-template.json). Human-required: EV code-signing certificate from approved CA; complete template on each test machine; clean-machine install/repair/upgrade/uninstall/rollback on managed Windows endpoint; attested hashes for FFmpeg, model, and all wheels. FFmpeg and Whisper binary_sha256 remain null in sbom/hash-manifest.json until IT verifies on qualified endpoint.
gates.next_action: IT packaging and security lead runs scripts/build/build_offline_wheelhouse.ps1 and scripts/build/build_msix.ps1 on managed endpoint, signs package with EV cert, fills evidence/installer/clean-machine-matrix-template.json, commits completed matrix.

gates.title: OS identity, authorization, and storage isolation
exit_criteria: The service identity and approved data ACL prevent access by unintended local principals.
Encryption, backup, indexing, recovery, and deletion propagation are tested on the managed endpoint.
A scoped penetration review accepts loopback, mutation-token, filesystem, and local-user boundaries.
blockers: STS-103 repo baseline committed: AuthProvider interface, DevAuthStub default, WindowsCredentialLockerProvider, ADR-008, STRIDE threat model; 15 auth tests plus 15 mock-based WindowsCredentialLockerProvider tests. Endpoint-config template committed (evidence/os/endpoint-config-template.json). STS_OS_AUTH_ENABLED=false by default — enforcement wiring deferred until QG-03 managed-endpoint qualification. Human-required: managed Windows endpoint; service identity (minimum-privilege Windows service account); complete evidence/os/endpoint-config-template.json; DPAPI encryption verified against service identity; backup/indexing exclusion; independent penetration test with no unresolved critical or high findings.
gates.next_action: Endpoint security lead provisions managed endpoint, configures service identity and data ACL, fills evidence/os/endpoint-config-template.json, runs DPAPI verification drill, and commissions independent penetration test.

gates.title: Accessibility and application security validation
exit_criteria: Automated semantic, keyboard, responsive, contrast, and security-header regressions pass.
Manual keyboard-only and supported screen-reader workflows pass on the approved browser matrix.
A scoped penetration test has no unresolved critical or high findings.
blockers: Pre-pentest hardening complete: all HTTP security headers audited (CSP no-wildcard, COOP, CORP, Permissions-Policy, Referrer-Policy), path traversal mitigated (UUID paths), SSRF not applicable, 11 new header tests added. Templates committed for screen-reader UAT (evidence/accessibility/screen-reader-matrix-template.json) and pen-test summary (evidence/security/pentest-report-summary-template.json). Human-required: independent penetration test with zero unresolved critical or high findings (fill pentest-report-summary-template.json); NVDA/JAWS screen-reader workflow on approved browser matrix (fill screen-reader-matrix-template.json).
gates.next_action: Accessibility and security owners commission independent penetration test, fill evidence/security/pentest-report-summary-template.json; execute NVDA/JAWS screen-reader workflow, fill evidence/accessibility/screen-reader-matrix-template.json.

gates.title: Export, retention, and external-copy governance
exit_criteria: The UI and manual clearly distinguish managed deletion from external copies.
Approved export destinations enforce retention, DLP, ACL, and deletion policy.
Operator training and a deletion/recovery drill are accepted by records and privacy owners.
blockers: All QG-05 evidence committed: DLP matrix (5 data types), retention policy (365-day non-waivable audit floor), deletion drill guide, operator training draft, operator checklist. Human-required: DPO (muammarlone@gmail.com) must review and update approved_by field in evidence/governance/dlp-matrix.json and evidence/governance/retention-policy.json. DT-03 export prohibition and 365-day floor are non-waivable covenants per AUDIT_SINGLE_PURPOSE_PRINCIPLE.md.
gates.next_action: DPO (muammarlone@gmail.com) reviews dlp-matrix.json and retention-policy.json, updates approved_by with name and date, and commits the updated files. This closes QG-05.

gates.title: Performance, capacity, and recovery matrix
exit_criteria: Approved CPU, memory, storage, and Windows profiles meet declared throughput and capacity thresholds.
Long-media, full-disk, interrupted-process, restart, and recovery drills stop safely.
P50 and P95 processing, resource, failure, and recovery measurements are retained by profile.
blockers: ASSUMPTION: Dev-machine batch run (3 MP4s, 24.6 MB, 140 s) in evidence/capacity/batch-capacity-run-20260730.json. Profiling script committed with live mode wired (scripts/perf/run_synthetic_profiling.py): _live_process submits WAV to HTTP service, polls /api/jobs/{id}, records wall-time and CPU/RSS via psutil if available. VERBATIM_PERF_LIVE=1 guard enforced. SC-04 full-disk scenario PENDING_HUMAN. Human-required: service running with real Whisper model; VERBATIM_PERF_LIVE=1 set; profiling script run on qualified corporate endpoint; IT acceptance of P50/P95 thresholds; full-disk, process-termination, and recovery drills.
gates.next_action: IT Systems Engineer runs scripts/perf/run_synthetic_profiling.py --live --service-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 on qualified corporate endpoint with VERBATIM_PERF_LIVE=1, completes SC-04 full-disk drill, and commits managed-endpoint results to evidence/capacity/.

gates.title: Protected archive and Zoom intake
exit_criteria: Credential providers, archive extraction, and Zoom OAuth have separate approved threat models and ADRs.
Secret lifecycle, hostile archive, SSRF, redirect, scope, retry, revocation, and cleanup tests pass.
Each capability is disabled by default until its own promotion decision.
blockers: Credential resolution, archive extraction, Zoom retrieval, and Teams connector are intentionally not implemented. ADR-006 defines connector isolation model and pre-implementation requirements per platform.
gates.next_action: Connector security lead reviews ADR-006 and approves per-platform threat models. Do not start connector implementation until phase-1 trust gates have accountable owners and accepted plans.

gates.title: Truthful release evidence and promotion control
exit_criteria: Architecture, product, roadmap, source hashes, metrics, and claim-boundary validators pass.
Promotion remains blocked while any promotion-blocking quality gate is not passed.
Release evidence identifies open risks, owner roles, next actions, and a conditional decision.
gates.next_action: Release governance reruns all validators for each candidate and rejects unsupported readiness claims.
